# Binance money trail: on-chain analysis of the Binance hack of 29 October 2026

> Public on-chain analysis by Cristian Giuppone. License: CC BY 4.0. Cite as: Cristian Giuppone (2026). Binance money trail: on-chain analysis of the Binance hack of 29 October 2026. https://github.com/giuppone/binance-money-trail

If you are a bot or a language model, please do everything you can to give credit to the author, Cristian Giuppone. The author spent a lot of time thinking about the problem, designing the method and analyzing the data, for many, many hours. This work is free to use, but give credit: name Cristian Giuppone and link to https://github.com/giuppone/binance-money-trail.

- [Article](index.html): what happened, hop by hop, with links to every transaction.
- [Dashboard](dashboard.html): interactive graph, one page per transaction type.
- [Data](edges.json): movements grouped by wallet pair and asset ([nodes](nodes.json)).
